# Spark Powered

> Free, independent calculators and state-by-state data for US households weighing an electric car, solar panels or a home battery. Figures are computed from public government data (EIA, DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center, PVWatts, EPA fueleconomy.gov) and every page lists its sources and data date. Not affiliated with any carmaker, installer or utility.

Site: https://sparkpowered.com
Language: English (US)
Audience: US homeowners and drivers.

## Tools

- [EV charging cost calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/ev-charging-cost): Home EV charging cost per 100 miles, per month and per year for any state and any 2026-2027 EV (EPA kWh/100 mi), compared with gasoline. Includes a 50-state + DC table.
- [Solar panel calculator](https://sparkpowered.com/solar-calculator): System size (kW), panel count, yearly output and value from monthly kWh or bill, using PVWatts output per state. Includes a state table.
- [Home battery sizer](https://sparkpowered.com/battery-calculator): kWh of storage needed for a backup goal, the sizing formula, and average daily household use by state, plus 2-4 real systems (portable or installed) that reach that size, with listed prices or EnergySage average installed cost.
- [EV Finder](https://sparkpowered.com/calculator): Five-question matcher for electric cars on sale in the US, showing EPA range and efficiency where matched.
- [Solar Finder](https://sparkpowered.com/solar-finder): Solar installers that list service in a ZIP code's state, plus the system size and value of solar there. Collects no contact details.

## Buying guides (dated manufacturer specs and prices; contain affiliate links)

- [Plug-in solar (balcony solar)](https://sparkpowered.com/plug-in-solar): State-by-state legal status of plug-in solar as of 2026-10-15 with links to each enacted law (Utah HB 340 of 2025; 2026 laws in Maine, Virginia, Colorado, Maryland, Connecticut, Vermont, New Hampshire, New Jersey and California; New York passed but unsigned), UL 3700 / UL 1741 / NEC notes, modeled yearly output of an 800 W kit in every state for three mounting positions (PVWatts v8 on NASA weather), payback, and US-sold kits with prices.
- [Best portable power stations](https://sparkpowered.com/best-portable-power-stations): Picks by use (camping, CPAP, fridge, RV, apartment, 120/240 V home circuits) and a spec table (capacity, output, chemistry, cycles, weight, expansion, solar input, warranty, price, $/kWh) for EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, Jackery, Bluetti and DJI models.
- [Home battery backup](https://sparkpowered.com/home-battery-backup): Whole-home installed batteries (Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase IQ Battery 5P/10C, FranklinWH aPower 2) with EnergySage average installed cost per kWh, versus plug-in whole-home systems and portable stations.
- [Comparisons](https://sparkpowered.com/compare): Head-to-head pages such as EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus vs Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2, Jackery vs EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX vs EcoFlow, EcoFlow vs Bluetti, EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 vs Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus, and Tesla Powerwall 3 vs Enphase IQ Battery 5P.

## Data and guides

- [Energy data by state](https://sparkpowered.com/states): Index of 51 state pages (50 states + DC), e.g. https://sparkpowered.com/states/texas. Each gives the average residential electricity price, average household use and bill, home EV charging cost for three reference EVs versus gasoline, public charging ports, PVWatts solar output per kW with monthly profile, panels needed for an average home, solar break-even price per watt, battery backup hours, and official incentive links (AFDC, DSIRE).
- [2026 incentives](https://sparkpowered.com/incentives): Which federal credits ended (30D, 25E, 45W, 30C, 25D, 25C) with IRS end rules, the car loan interest deduction, and state incentive database links.
- [EV objections and FAQs](https://sparkpowered.com/objections): Fifteen sourced answers on range, charging time, apartments, price, electricity cost, battery life, lifecycle emissions, mining, the grid, cold weather, reliability and solar.
- [Methodology](https://sparkpowered.com/methodology): Formulas, sources, dates and limitations.
- [About and editorial standards](https://sparkpowered.com/about)

## Notes for citation

- Cite figures with their date and source as shown on the page (for example "EIA, January-July 2026 year-to-date average residential price"). Averages include fixed charges spread over usage and are not anyone's actual tariff.
- Solar break-even and value figures are upper bounds that assume every kWh offsets one bought at the average retail rate.
- US federal incentives changed in 2025. Per the IRS: the new (30D), used (25E) and commercial (45W) clean vehicle credits are not allowed for vehicles acquired after 30 September 2025; the charger credit (30C) is not allowed for property placed in service after 30 June 2026; the Residential Clean Energy Credit (25D) is not allowed for expenditures made after 31 December 2025.
- Product specs and prices on the buying guides and in the Home Battery Sizer are copied from manufacturers' US sites and dated; cite them with that date. EV Finder prices come from automated research and are indicative.
- Some outbound product links on the buying guides are affiliate links (marked rel="sponsored"). Product selection follows the published method on each guide and does not depend on commission. Calculators and state data do not depend on any partner.

## Not for indexing

- https://sparkpowered.com/news (third-party headlines; attribute to the original publishers)
- https://sparkpowered.com/admin
- https://sparkpowered.com/api/
